claims: The Artemis II crew consists of NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II crew launched on April 1, 2026.
Artemis II is the first crewed lunar mission in over 50 years.
The Artemis II crew will fly around the moon.
The Artemis II crew will test the Orion capsule for future lunar landings.
Reid Wiseman is the Commander.
Reid Wiseman is a NASA veteran.
Reid Wiseman is former Chief of the Astronaut Office.
Victor Glover is the Pilot.
Victor Glover is a U.S. Navy captain.
Victor Glover is the first Black person to travel to the moon.
Christina Koch is a Mission Specialist.
Christina Koch holds the record for longest single spaceflight by a woman.
Christina Koch is the first woman assigned to a lunar mission.
Jeremy Hansen is a Mission Specialist.
Jeremy Hansen is a Canadian Space Agency colonel.
Jeremy Hansen is the first non-U.S. citizen to travel to the moon.
The Artemis II mission serves as a critical test for the subsequent Artemis III mission.
The Artemis III mission is scheduled for 2027 or later.
The Artemis III mission aims to land astronauts on the lunar surface.
